items.name: DACAT ROOKIE CARD 2026 - FIRST ROUND
items.description:
The 2026 DACAT ROOKIE CARD is a limited-edition community NFT created to welcome new members to DACAT. Only 333 First Round DACAT Rookie Cards will be issued for 2026. Additional subsequent rookie  rounds may be introduced in the future.

These cards are awarded by members of the DACAT Community to individuals who show an interest in building, creating, collecting, participating in, or contributing to the growth of DACAT.

The Rookie Card is a symbol of recognition and community participation. It is not a purchase, investment contract, security, or promise of future rewards, compensation, or financial benefit.

Rookie Card holders may be considered for future community activities, events, contests, recognition programs, and Rookie of the Year initiatives as determined by community members. Participation in any future activity, program, or recognition is not guaranteed.

Welcome to DACAT!

We hope you have an amazing 2026 rookie season and go on to become a true DACAT LEGEND.

items.name: DATRAIL CAT - DACAT 1 TRILLION CLUB MEMBERSHIP
items.description:
Exclusive 1 of 1 NFT minted to honor DATRAILCAT.ETH into the DACAT 1 TRILLION CLUB

The DACAT 1 TRILLION CLUB is an elite NFT membership collection created to recognize the legendary diamond handed holders of at least 1,000,000,000,000 DaCAT tokens or more in a single ENS ETH wallet.

Each NFT serves as a digital badge of conviction, loyalty, and belief in the future of the DACAT UNIVERSE and community. Built for the earliest and strongest supporters, the collection celebrates those bold enough to hold through the early days and help build something bigger than a token — a decentralized entertainment movement powered by creators, collectors, and community.

Holding a DACAT 1 TRILLION CLUB NFT represents:

- Membership in one of the highest-tier DaCAT holder groups

- Recognition as an early supporter of the DACAT ecosystem

- A collectible piece of DACAT history

- Potential access to future community events, rewards, and recognition opportunities

- Proof of commitment to the vision of BUILD YOUR WORLD WITH DACAT

DACAT TOKEN was launched on January 23, 2024

Celebrate DACAT DAY on March 3, 2033

Where will you be on 3-3-33

items.name: COLLECTOR CAT - FIRST APPEARANCE
items.description:
Collector Cat makes his first appearance in the DACAT WORLD universe. A legendary explorer from the planet Cryptosphere, Collector Cat travels across the stars in search of rare artifacts, forgotten treasures, and lost pieces of history. Known for his determination, courage, and passion for collecting, he is always searching for the next great discovery hidden somewhere in the universe.

This NFT commemorates the debut appearance of Collector Cat and serves as a collectible milestone within the expanding DACAT WORLD character roster.

Collector Cat is an original character created by Russell Corey and is part of the DACAT WORLD intellectual property. Any appearances of Collector Cat in third-party publications, stories, comics, or media do not transfer ownership of the character or the underlying intellectual property.
